cards.card_text: The Ninevites proclaim a fast and dress in sackcloth.
When the Ninevites fast and dress in sackcloth, who joins in?
Jesus says that as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
cards.verse_text: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
